additionalContainerArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the sidecar container. Do not set `--log-level` here, use `logLevel`.

value.description: Value of the environment variable. Cannot be used together with `valueFrom`.

key.description: The key to select from the ConfigMap.

optional.description: Whether the ConfigMap or its key must exist.

configMapKeyRef.description: Selects a key of a ConfigMap.

apiVersion.description: Version of the schema the field path is written in, defaults to `v1`.

fieldPath.description: Path of the Pod field to select.

fieldRef.description: Selects a field of the Pod.

key.description: The key within the env file.

optional.description: Whether the file or its key must exist.

path.description: Path within the volume to select the file from. Must be relative.

volumeName.description: Name of the volume mount containing the env file.

fileKeyRef.description: Selects a key of an env file.

containerName.description: Container name, optional for env vars.

divisor.description: Output format of the exposed resource, defaults to `1`.

resource.description: Resource to select, such as `limits.cpu` or `requests.memory`.

resourceFieldRef.description: Selects a resource of the container.

key.description: The key of the Secret to select from.

optional.description: Whether the Secret or its key must exist.

secretKeyRef.description: Selects a key of a Secret.

valueFrom.description: Source for the environment variable's value. Cannot be used if `value` is set.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the sidecar container.

logLevel.description: Log level of the PostgreSQL instance sidecar.

name.description: Name of a resource from `spec.resourceClaims` used by the sidecar container.

request.description: Name of the request in the referenced claim.

claims.description: Resource claims used by the sidecar container.

limits.description: Maximum compute resources allowed for the sidecar container, such as `cpu` or `memory`.

requests.description: Minimum compute resources required by the sidecar container, such as `cpu` or `memory`.

resources.description: Compute resources of the sidecar container that runs in the instance pods.

retentionPolicyIntervalSeconds.description: Interval in seconds at which the sidecar checks and enforces retention policies.

description: Configuration of the sidecar that runs in the CNPG instance pods. Passed verbatim to the `instanceSidecarConfiguration` of the CNPG ObjectStore.
